trek.tag: Bikes for those who don't settle.
trek.desc: From Waterloo, Wisconsin, the brand that brought OCLV carbon to the Tour de France. Road, MTB, e-bike and city: here you'll find the Trek range with official service and a lifetime frame warranty.
trek.t1p: The lightest composite Trek has ever made: born in the wind tunnel, tested beyond standards.
trek.t2p: The decoupler that absorbs roughness without losing stiffness: effortless miles.
trek.t3p: Your Trek, your colours: the full customisation programme, orderable from us in store.

scott.desc: From the first aluminium ski pole to the fastest Foil in the bunch: Scott is lightweight engineering. We are an official dealer with the whole range: Foil, Addict, Scale, Spark, Lumen and the eRIDE e-bikes.
scott.t1p: Ultra-high-modulus fibres for frames under 900 grams: the Scale RC and Addict RC are born this way.
scott.t2p: Suspension and geometry adjust together, from the bars, while riding: three bikes in one.
scott.t3p: Invisible cables, one-piece cockpit, real aerodynamics: the Scott signature on road and mountain.

cannondale.desc: The brand that invented the Lefty fork and took aluminium where no one thought possible. SuperSix, Synapse, Scalpel, Habit and the Moterra e-bikes: the Cannondale range, with a workshop that truly knows them.
cannondale.t1p: High-strength resin and ballistic fibres: light frames that stand up to real life.
cannondale.t2p: One leg, more stiffness and sensitivity than many dual-crown forks: the Cannondale icon.
cannondale.t3p: Every size gets dedicated kinematics and stiffness: the bike works the same for every height.

amflow.tag: The e-MTB that changed the rules.
amflow.desc: 105 Nm DJI Avinox motor, integrated battery and lightweight-bike weight: the Amflow PL is the e-MTB everyone is talking about. We have it in store, ready to see and touch.
amflow.t1p: Compact like a lightweight, powerful like a full power: 105 Nm and drone-maker control.
amflow.t2p: Fast charge to 80% in an hour and a half and real climbing range.
amflow.t3p: Modern geometry, 150 mm of travel, OLED display integrated in the top tube.
